description: A two-room flat with a galley kitchen, a bed and a woodblock floor lifting at the corners. A picture window opens onto a balcony just wide enough for a chair. Below it the grass and the Strand run down to the Basin. Solenne, next door, blocks the morning sun. The bathroom is through a door at the back.

window.description: A bronze-framed picture window onto a narrow balcony with a glass rail, the Strand below and the Basin beyond.
window.name: the balcony window

name: Kestrel Court, Unit 3B
